summary: Renames the order detail view to show_order and limits its query to the fields the detail template renders.

findings.title: Renamed view still referenced by old name in URL config
findings.problem: This change renames order_detail to show_order. The file orders/urls.py line 8 still references views.order_detail.
findings.consequence: Django raises AttributeError when it loads the URL config. Every page of the site then fails, not only the order detail page.
findings.fix: Keep the original view name, or update orders/urls.py to reference views.show_order.
